standard-dialogue-human-form.npc: I don't know what you think you are doing here human, but I do know that you will not live long enough to leave this place.

standard-dialogue-monkey-form.npc: Welcome to the temple of Marimbo, child. In less busy times I would bless you, but I have not the luxury of free time at the moment.
However, feel free to stay here as long as you need.
